Product Outcome Design Document (PODD)
1. Introduction and Value Proposition
Company Leadership has tasked the Global Partner Sales and Route to Market organization to transform partner incentives, leveraging a new Incentive Engine. The goal is to build upon existing world-class partner incentive programs while modernizing the underlying technology to address current operational limitations.
Our strategic vision is to:
Consolidate and simplify channel incentives into a single, unified incentive

hannel incentives into a single, unified incentive structure, starting with major existing programs.
Provide a defined progression path for partners of all sizes and performance levels within the single unified incentive framework. Financial and non-financial rewards will be available based on eligibility achieved within a defined measurement period. (Note: Non-financial benefits are outside the scope of this incentive program).
Adjust incentives and metrics to align more closely with internal s

and metrics to align more closely with internal sales team metrics.
Better integrate diverse Sales Channels into incentives, starting with Managed Services.
Future-proof Partner Incentives to adapt quickly to new, expanding, or lagging markets.
The unified incentive will provide back-end rebates across all product/service categories for hardware, services, and software subscriptions sales. We aim to create an incentive platform that is flexible enough to manage current business needs and adapt

enough to manage current business needs and adapt quickly to future requirements, solutions, and partner motions.
Our tactical goals are to:
Provide stability through predictable incentives, while rewarding exceptional sales performance and ongoing investment in the company's solutions.
Drive recurring revenue.
Drive strategic growth.
Encourage up-sell and cross-sell by rewarding more for strategic offers.
Drive exceptional customer outcomes and experiences throughout the Customer Experience Lif

experiences throughout the Customer Experience Lifecycle.
Reward all Sales Channels in a similar and compatible manner.
Automate sales campaigns, incentive management, and reporting.
Enable rapid adjustment of incentive setup, including metric thresholds and payouts, within a 90-day window for market launch.
Ensure a world-class partner experience regardless of the sales channel or commercial platform they engage with.
Current incentive programs and their supporting tools will remain in producti

and their supporting tools will remain in production, in parallel with the new incentive program as it rolls out globally. This parallel operation will require continued support for existing business while building and supporting the new incentive. Continued calculation of legacy incentive programs will be required for a period of no less than 12 months as a contingency, for internal company purposes only, and will not be processed for payment.

Incentive Calculations
We need the ability to incentivize on each metric in three distinct ways:
Uplift: Additional percentage point applied to the published payout incentive percentage on the TCV prior to rebate calculation.
Multiplier: Whole number or fraction applied to the incentive rebate post-initial calculation to ei

he incentive rebate post-initial calculation to either increase or decrease total payout.
Flat fee: Preset dollar amount associated with an event or attainment threshold specified during the incentive measure setup.
Aggregated: Determining rewards based on the combined value of all transactions. Focus is on the cumulative value of the transactions, and rewards are applied based on the aggregated sum.
Aggregated is most closely aligned to internal sales compensation usage; however, aggregation wi

sales compensation usage; however, aggregation will simplify partner experience and payout while still driving differentiated behavior.
All incentive calculations use pre-attribution and pre-Fair Market Value (FMV) values.
Calculated at the transaction level - Order/Contract Line Level, for each PSI, incentives will be calculated for each of the partners.
Calculated at the PSI level utilizing a Good, Better, Best approach for TCV and the respective expansion and renewal motions.
